notes: Rule 58 split against MRK.8.1. Both verses have an anarthrous adjective with an expressed anarthrous noun and one supplied English *a*; 8.1 gives the determiner to the noun (*a ... multitude*, discontinuous under rule 15) and 8.7 gave it to the adjective (*a few*). Rule 58 assigns the determiner to the noun without exception and closes by forbidding exactly the reading that puts it on the adjective because it stands next to it, so 8.7 is brought into line: ὀλίγα keeps a bare *few* and ἰχθύδια takes the discontinuous *a ... small fishes*. No other unit in the verse changes.
